common_profile_prompt: Square mobile game profile portrait. Preserve the exact yellow Chihuahua identity, head proportions, large upright ears, cream eyebrows/muzzle/inner ears, huge brown eyes, brown nose, cute expression and screen-right gaze from the attached mandatory reference. Match its flat 2D cartoon style: thick smooth black outlines, rounded simple shapes, bright flat colors, subtle cel shading and tiny cream highlights. Head-and-ears only, centered, full ears visible, generous transparent padding, genuine RGBA alpha. No body, weapon, gloves, shoes, text, watermark, realism, fur texture, painterly or complex anime rendering, colored outlines or dramatic glow.
common_map_prompt: Portrait 573:709 mobile game lobby chapter map. The attached character_base.png is the mandatory drawing-style reference only; do not draw the Chihuahua. Match its cheerful flat 2D cartoon style with thick smooth black outlines, rounded simplified forms, bright clean colors, subtle cel shading and small cream highlights. A broad winding path starts at bottom center and leads upward through layered scenery. No characters, animals, UI frame, text, letters, numbers, icons or watermark. Opaque full-canvas environment.
